composition.reason: Four uses of the existing plain-rule construction surround six settings of already identified Celtic No. 2 cuts. Preserve source geometry and uneven joins as assembly evidence; no whole-frame icon or isolated corner identity is created.

measurement_method: Median25-pixel native grayscale profiles at three positions per edge; contrast-weighted centroid within5pixels of the peak; linearly interpolated half-depth width. Three measured centroids define each fitted edge axis. Geometry documents the assembled impression; no scan warping, analytic redraw or new icon is performed.
construction_decision: Four dimensional and rotational uses of the existing plain-rule construction. Retain the composition with original type rows and corner joins. The longer blurred source and joined endpoints do not supersede the isolated Boston drawing.

comparison.identity_scope: Construction correspondence only. The sources do not establish common punches, matrices or physical rule stock. Long/short and vertical/horizontal dimensions are not substituted into the canonical outline.
